review: Viewed front, reverse, edge and oblique actual-loader mesh plots. Published panel size and explicitly estimated case envelope surround original controller/adapter CAD. No external panel CAD was available in the source ZIP. Ports, speakers, camera apertures and exact final assembly placement remain unresolved; no hardware-fit or WebGL acceptance.
imageScope: Geometry-only CPU plots; dark blue screen swatch is a review aid and not firmware output.
